responsibility: This file implements GCC’s tiny three-valued boolean utility type, providing textual formatting and logical negation, conjunction, and disjunction over TRUE, FALSE, and UNKNOWN values according to GCC’s chosen truth tables. It also contains checking-build selftests that validate construction, comparison, and operator semantics. Its role is a reusable support utility for analyses that need to represent uncertainty explicitly instead of collapsing to binary bools.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/tristate.h, which defines the tristate class interface and inline operators, this .cc file provides the out-of-line behavior for string conversion and three-valued logic operations, and also houses the checking-only selftests for that utility.
